name: Aphrodite
ability: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): they learn who you are. If either of you dies, the other dies too.
flavor: Love is the one bond even the gods cannot cut.
firstNightReminder: The Aphrodite chooses a player: mark them ROSE. Wake that player, show them the Aphrodite token, and point to the Aphrodite.

name: Hestia
ability: You start knowing 1 in-play evil character. When that player dies, that night you learn another in-play evil character.
flavor: The hearth sees every face that gathers around it.
firstNightReminder: Show an in-play evil character token. Mark that player KNOW.
otherNightReminder: If the KNOW player has died, show another in-play evil character token and move KNOW to that player.

name: Hermes
ability: You start knowing if an evil player is within 2 seats of you. All Travellers share your alignment, even if you are dead.
flavor: Messenger, trickster, and patron of everyone on the road.
firstNightReminder: Nod if an evil player is within 2 seats of the Hermes; shake your head if not.

name: Dionysus
ability: Each night*, you learn how many players' abilities malfunctioned since dawn.
flavor: Wine reveals what sobriety hides — mostly who has had too much.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal: how many abilities malfunctioned since dawn.

name: Artemis
ability: Each night*, choose an alive player (not yourself): you learn if they woke tonight due to an ability.
flavor: The huntress hears every footstep in the dark forest.
otherNightReminder: The Artemis chooses a player. Nod if that player woke tonight.

name: Demeter
ability: Each night, choose 2 players (not yourself). If you choose an evil player, you lose this ability. Once you have chosen every other living good player, good wins.
flavor: She counts every seed she has sown — and every one that rotted.
firstNightReminder: The Demeter chooses 2 players: mark them HARVESTED. If either is evil, mark the Demeter NO ABILITY.
otherNightReminder: The Demeter chooses 2 players: mark them HARVESTED. If either is evil, mark the Demeter NO ABILITY. If every other living good player is HARVESTED, good wins.

name: Hephaestus
ability: Each night, you learn how many evil players are alive. [+0 to +2 Hephaestus. If there is more than one, one of them registers as evil]
flavor: Forged in fire, flawed by design — one of his works is always cracked.
firstNightReminder: Give a finger signal: the number of living evil players.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal: the number of living evil players.

name: Hera
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: if a Minion or Demon chose either of them tonight, you learn one of their alignments.
flavor: Queen of the gods. She notices everyone who sneaks around the palace.
firstNightReminder: The Hera chooses 2 players. If a Minion or Demon chose either tonight, show a thumbs up or down for one of them.
otherNightReminder: The Hera chooses 2 players. If a Minion or Demon chose either tonight, show a thumbs up or down for one of them.

name: Apollo
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: one of them gets true information tonight, if they get any.
flavor: His oracle has never lied, only been misread.
firstNightReminder: The Apollo chooses 2 players. Mark one of them PURIFIED: their information tonight is true.
otherNightReminder: The Apollo chooses 2 players. Mark one of them PURIFIED: their information tonight is true.

name: Poseidon
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): if they would die tonight, a player of the Storyteller's choice might die instead.
flavor: Ask him for a calm sea and he may just send the wave somewhere else.
otherNightReminder: The Poseidon chooses a player: mark them TSUNAMI.

name: Zeus
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die. If they are good, they become a Prometheus.
flavor: Zeus’s power is mighty, though his judgments can have unintended consequences.

name: Ares
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly challenge another player to a duel of rock-paper-scissors. The loser is executed and turns evil.
flavor: War doesn't care who is right — only who is left.

name: Athena
ability: Once per game, during the day, make a public statement about another player's alignment. Tonight, you learn if it was true.
flavor: Wisdom is knowing which accusations to make out loud.
otherNightReminder: If the Athena made a statement today, nod if it was true; shake your head if not.

name: Atlas
ability: Each day, you must vote exactly once, or tomorrow your vote counts as negative. Once per game, evil may publicly guess who you are: if correct, evil wins.
flavor: He holds up the sky, and would really like someone else to take a turn.

name: Pandora
ability: Once per game, at night, open the box: every player's ability malfunctions until dusk. If you die before using this, the box opens that night.
flavor: Don't open it. Don't open it. Don't — she opened it.
firstNightReminder: The Pandora may open the box. If so, mark ALL MALFUNCTION: every ability malfunctions until dusk.
otherNightReminder: The Pandora may open the box (it opens anyway if the Pandora died since dawn). If so, mark ALL MALFUNCTION: every ability malfunctions until dusk.

name: Helios
ability: If a good player nominates you, they immediately become a Prometheus.
flavor: Fly too close and you'll get burned — or something stranger.

name: Prometheus
ability: You do not know you are a Prometheus: you think you are a Townsfolk. You might register as an evil Minion or Demon, even if dead.
flavor: He stole fire for mankind and has been paying for it ever since.

name: Phobos
ability: You start knowing Ares & Aphrodite, and they learn a Phobos is in play. If both are alive when just 4 players live, evil wins, even if you are dead. [+Ares & Aphrodite]
flavor: The child of love and war knows exactly how both of them end.
firstNightReminder: Point to the Ares and the Aphrodite for the Phobos. Then wake the Ares and the Aphrodite together and show them the Phobos token.

name: Eris
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: if one is a Prometheus, the other gains the Prometheus ability until dusk. [+1 Prometheus]
flavor: One golden apple, three goddesses, and a war that lasted ten years.
firstNightReminder: The Eris chooses 2 players. If one is a Prometheus, mark the other DISCORD.
otherNightReminder: The Eris chooses 2 players. If one is a Prometheus, mark the other DISCORD.

name: Medusa
ability: Each night, choose a player: their ability doesn't work until dusk. They learn they met the Medusa's gaze.
flavor: One look is all it takes.
firstNightReminder: The Medusa chooses a player: mark them STONED. Wake that player and show them the Medusa token.
otherNightReminder: The Medusa chooses a player: mark them STONED. Wake that player and show them the Medusa token.

name: Nemesis
ability: If an evil player died today, choose a player tonight: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
flavor: Every debt gets collected eventually.
otherNightReminder: If an evil player died today, the Nemesis chooses a player: they die, even if protected.

name: Thanatos
ability: Each night, choose a player: the player you chose last night dies. Once per game, if you would die while 4 or more players live, your current choice dies instead.
flavor: Death is never late. He is simply a day behind.
firstNightReminder: The Thanatos chooses a player: mark them MARKED.
otherNightReminder: The MARKED player dies. The Thanatos chooses a player: mark them MARKED.

name: Typhon
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. If you kill the Zeus, they learn you are one of 3 players. [+Zeus]
flavor: Father of all monsters, and the only thing Zeus ever feared.
otherNightReminder: The Typhon chooses 2 players: they die. If one was the Zeus, wake the Zeus and point to 3 players, one of whom is the Typhon.

name: Kronos
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you learn their character, then they die. Once per game, after learning, you may choose a different player to die instead.
flavor: He devoured his own children rather than be replaced.
otherNightReminder: The Kronos chooses a player: show their character token. Once per game, the Kronos may then choose a different player. The final choice dies.

name: Hades
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you die while 5 or more players are alive, an alive Minion becomes the Hades.
flavor: Every soul finds its way to him in the end.
otherNightReminder: The Hades chooses a player: they die.
